children: China medical device maker's H1 revenue rose 41% yr/yr, driven by caFFR system sales
Net loss attributable to shareholders narrowed to RMB22 mln, reflecting ongoing R&D and commercialization costs
No interim dividend declared for the period
caFFR SYSTEM SALES - Revenue growth was mainly driven by sales of FlashPressure caFFR pressure transducer
NEW PRODUCT CONTRIBUTION - Coronary artery cutting balloon product began contributing to revenue, aided by inclusion in national centralized bulk procurement scope
ONGOING EXPENSES - Net loss was mainly attributable to ongoing expenses for research and development, manufacturing and commercialization
